# NexHaat Security Incident Runbook

- Treat suspected credential exposure, unauthorized access, payment abuse, tenant
  boundary failure, data exfiltration, and malicious dependency compromise as urgent.
- Preserve logs, timestamps, affected SHAs, alert IDs, and relevant request IDs.
- Do not paste credentials or personal records into issues, chat, or agent prompts.
- Restrict access or revoke/rotate credentials only through an authorized owner and
  the documented provider process.
- Assess whether customer, seller, staff, or payment data may be affected.
- Identify affected code, dependencies, workflows, secrets, and time window.
- Contain first; patch and deploy only after review and approval.
- Follow applicable legal, contractual, provider, and organizational notification rules.
- Record evidence, actions, residual risk, and follow-up controls.
